newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to file patent suit against Qualcomm.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to file patent suit against Qualcomm.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Thursday it intends to file a patent infringement suit against Qualcomm Inc, alleging Qualcomm's Q phone copies the design of Motorola's handheld StarTAC digital cellular phone.
"Motorola intends to file a patent infringement suit against Qualcomm Inc," said Wolf Pavlok, senior vice president and general manager of Motorola's Pan American Cellular Subscriber Group.

"The new Qualcommm QCM series of Code Division Multiple Access, or CDMA, digital cell phones copies the basic look, including the key design elements and functional features of Motorola's StarTAC wearable telephones," Pavlok said in a conference call with reporters.

A Motorola attorney said the suit will be filed "very rapidly," as soon as the necessary papers are prepared. He said the suit will seek an injunction to prevent Qualcomm from selling the phones, among other things.
Motorola is still reviewing whether to seek monetary damages, he said.
